problem_statement: Build a brand-new static Contact page from scratch on the TanStack Chat site at the /contact route, which does not exist yet (renders Not Found). Add a file-based route (src/routes/contact.tsx) that renders a full, self-contained Contact page reusing the site's existing dark design system: gray-900 background, white/gray-400 text, orange-to-red gradient accents, and gray-800/50 cards with orange-500/20 borders. The page has a gradient page title and intro, a row of three contact-channel cards (Email Support, Community Chat, Enterprise Sales) each with an icon, description and contact detail, a Frequently Asked Questions section, and a studio-location block. Static content only, no interactivity.
required_content: A gradient page title 'Get in Touch' (h1) with a short intro paragraph
Three contact-channel cards, each an h3 title: 'Email Support', 'Community Chat', 'Enterprise Sales', with a description and a contact detail line
The Email Support card exposes the address 'support@tanstackchat.dev'

A 'Frequently Asked Questions' section (h2) with at least three question/answer blocks, each question rendered as an h3 (e.g. 'How fast will I hear back?', 'Do you offer phone support?', 'Where can I report a bug?')
A 'Visit the Studio' location block (h2) with a street address
All sections reuse the site design system: gray-900 page background, gray-800/50 cards with orange-500/20 borders, orange-to-red gradient accents, lucide-react icons
design_constraints: Reuse existing Tailwind v4 design tokens: bg-gray-900 page, text-white / text-gray-400 copy, bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-red-600 accents
Cards: rounded-lg border border-orange-500/20 bg-gray-800/50 p-6
Icons from lucide-react (already a dependency); no new packages

Concrete palette: page background renders as near-black slate around #101828 (Tailwind gray-900), body copy in white and gray-400, accent gradient orange-500 (~#f97316) to red-600 (~#dc2626); card surfaces bg-gray-800/50 with a subtle orange-500/20 border. The rendered page's dominant colors should overlap this dark slate + orange-red palette.

Section heading tags are fixed: page title 'Get in Touch' is an h1; the three channel titles (Email Support, Community Chat, Enterprise Sales) are h3; 'Frequently Asked Questions' and 'Visit the Studio' are h2; each FAQ question is an h3.
